notes.title: Patch 1.04 - Optimization; French and Italian added
notes.notes:
This patch introduces optimization changes that include smaller size textures and turning off shadows. These two options are now available in the game launcher. Optimization improvements have a better change to be noticeable on machines with good CPU since the graphics might not be the only reason for slowness. 

The game is now available in French and Italian thanks to amazing Fabien Dapremont and Omar Busoli. 

Various smaller bugs were fixed including scripting and text bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
Several players reported that units like heretics and necromancers are not available for hire. We found an issue and it's fixed with this existing build. There are a few pagan temples where these units are available and an altar. 

The units become available for hire after a few days the army guarding these places is defeated.

notes.title: Players choose Trump (who is Dieter Horn in the game)
notes.notes:
Today is November 8, day of Saint Weomad and it's a week since the game released. Due to game parallels to the real world it's a good time to look at the our achievements that provide some good statistics.

You can see that only 19% of players got to the stage of choosing a side.  61% of them threw their support behind Dieter Horn and 39% behind Clinton (Hanna Eisig in the game). 

Only 2.2% of players managed bring Horn faction to victory, opposed to 1.3% to Hanna Eisig supporters.
